description: DR-0004's ERD, generated: every PocketBase collection and system table at the snapshot's revision, the platform tables and stores DR-0004 places, and every relation with its cardinality, account partition, delete behavior, merge behavior, and indexes. The written fields come from erd-decisions.json, which DR-0004 ratifies; the rest comes from schema-snapshot.json through node scripts/conformance/run.mjs --write.

onDelete.cascade: Deleting the target deletes this row in the same transaction.
onDelete.restrict: Deleting the target is refused while this row points at it.
onDelete.unset: Deleting the target removes its id from this field and keeps the row.
onDelete.purge: Nothing happens in the delete's transaction; #76 removes the row in batches afterward.

onAccountDelete.expiry: The row outlives the account until its own expiry removes it.
onAccountDelete.pocketbase: PocketBase removes the row itself when it deletes the account.

merge.none: No merge redirects this field; when its target goes, the field's delete behavior applies.
merge.repoint: A merge of the target moves this field to the surviving record, inside the merge's transaction.
merge.n/a: The field names the owning account, and no merge crosses accounts, so it never changes.
